set.statement: While CI is unstable, the built-in ship-change workflow runs the project's local gate command (rhiza.ship.localGate; make gate for Rhiza itself) in the run's worktree before every push and pushes only when it exits 0, sending a failing gate to a fixer like a red CI; while CI is stable, or with no gate set, the step passes at once and the run keeps its scoped tests
